results.name: Barbell Coan Deadlift
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing slightly outward. Position a barbell over the middle of your feet, and squat down to grip the barbell with both hands inside your legs, using an overhand grip.
Brace your core and drive through your heels as you extend your knees and hips simultaneously, keeping the barbell close to your legs throughout the lift.
Stand fully upright squeezing your glutes at the top of the exercise. Keep your shoulders back, and the bar resting against your thighs.
Hinge at your hips first, then bend your knees to lower the barbell under control along the same path until it returns to the floor.
tips: Keep the barbell as close to your body as possible throughout the lift and avoid rounding your lower back.
Drive through your heels while extending your hips and keep your chest up.
Avoid jerking the bar from the floor during the beginning of the lift and lower the barbell in a controlled fashion while hinging at the hip joint.
Exhale as you complete the lift and inhale before beginning the next repetition.
results.description: Barbell Coan Deadlift is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Traps, Lats, Forearms.

results.name: Barbell Deadlift High Pull
instructions: Place a barbell on the floor in front of you. Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and your toes pointed slightly outward.
Hinge at your hips and bend your knees to lower your body, grip the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.

Push through your heels to lift the barbell off the floor, extending your hips and knees simultaneously. As you reach the standing position, pull the barbell upward towards your chin by bending your elbows and keeping them pointed outward.
Lower the barbell back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Use a weight that allows you to maintain proper form throughout the exercise.
Push through your heels to maximize power and stability.
Ensure your knees track over your toes to prevent knee strain.
results.description: Barbell Deadlift High Pull is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Upper Back, Lower Back.

results.name: Barbell Reverse Deadlift
instructions: Stand with your feet at shoulder-width apart facing away from the barbell.
Squat down and grip the barbell behind your legs with an overhand grip.
Begin the lift by pushing through your heels, extending your hips and knees to lift the barbell off the floor until you stand up straight.
Lower the barbell back to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep the barbell close to your legs throughout the movement.
Push your hips back as you lower the barbell. Avoid rounding your lower back.
Keep your chest up and your core tight throughout the exercise.
Inhale as you lower the barbell and exhale as you stand up.
results.description: Barbell Reverse Deadlift is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Upper Back, Forearms.

results.name: Barbell Reverse Grip Bent Over Row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with a reverse grip (palms facing forward), hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Bend at the hips and knees to lower your torso until it is nearly parallel to the floor, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Pull the barbell towards your abdomen by bending your elbows.
Lower the barbell back to the starting position with control, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Focus on squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement to maximize back muscle activation.
Use a weight that allows for proper form and control throughout the exercise to prevent strain or injury.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you pull the barbell up and inhaling as you lower it back down.
results.description: Barbell Reverse Grip Bent Over Row is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Biceps, Forearms.

results.name: Barbell Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing slightly outward. Position a barbell on the floor in front of you, and squat down to grip the barbell with both hands inside your legs, using an overhand grip (palms facing down).
Drive through your heels and extend your hips and knees simultaneously to lift the barbell off the floor. Keep the barbell close to your body and your arms straight as you stand up.

Once you reach the top position, squeeze your glutes and stand tall. Slowly lower the barbell back to the floor by bending at the hips and knees, maintaining a straight back. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your chest up and back straight throughout the movement to avoid rounding your spine.
Drive through your heels to lift the barbell and engage your glutes and hamstrings.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift the barbell and inhaling as you lower it back down.
results.description: Barbell Sumo Deadlift is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Adductors, Lower Back.

results.name: Barbell Zercher Good Morning
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and hold the barbell securely in the bend of your elbows against your chest.
Hinge at your hips and lower your torso forward while keeping your knees slightly bent and your back straight.
Lower your torso until you feel a comfortable stretch in your hamstrings, pause for 1-2 seconds, then drive your hips forward to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions while keeping the barbell close to your body.
tips: Push your hips back to initiate the movement instead of bending at the waist.
Keep your chest up and your core tight during every repetition.
Keep your back straight and maintain a neutral spine throughout the movement.
Inhale as you lower your torso and exhale as you return to the starting position.
results.description: Barbell Zercher Good Morning is an advanced multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core, Upper Back, Biceps.

results.name: Behind Neck Lat Pull Down Machine
instructions: Sit at a lat pulldown machine with your feet flat on the floor. Grasp the bar with a wide overhand grip (palms facing forward).
Lean slightly forward and pull the bar down behind your neck, keeping your elbows pointed down.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together as you bring the bar down to the back of your neck.
Slowly return the bar to the starting position, extending your arms fully without locking your elbows. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Maintain a slight forward lean to avoid excessive neck strain.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you pull the bar down and inhaling as you return to the starting position.
Ensure the knee pad is securely positioned to prevent your legs from lifting during the movement.
results.description: Behind Neck Lat Pull Down Machine is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps, Upper Back.

results.name: Bent Over Row Resistance Band
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding the handles of a resistance band anchored under your feet. Hinge at the hips with a slight bend in your knees to bring your torso almost parallel to the floor.
Start with your arms extended towards the floor, holding the band with your palms facing each other.
Pull the handles of the band towards your hips by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your body and squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Slowly return to the starting position, extending your arms back towards the floor. Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your elbows close to your body to maximize back engagement and minimize shoulder involvement.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement to enhance muscle activation.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you pull the band and inhaling as you return to the starting position.
results.description: Bent Over Row Resistance Band is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Biceps.

results.name: Cable Lat Prayer
instructions: Stand facing a cable machine and hold the handles overhead with your arms fully extended. Hinge at your hips and lean forward until your torso is parallel to the floor.
Keeping your arms straight, pull the handles downward in an arc toward your thighs.
Pause briefly while squeezing your lats at the bottom of the movement.
Slowly return the handles to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep a slight bend in your elbows throughout the exercise.
Hinge at your hips and maintain a neutral spine.
Control the movement and avoid using momentum.
Inhale as you return the handles overhead and exhale as you pull them downward.
results.description: Cable Lat Prayer is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Shoulders, Core.

results.name: Cable Pull in Kneeling
instructions: Stand in a half-kneeling position with the cable pulley beside you. Hold the handle with your left hand, palm facing forward, while the right leg is positioned forward for stability.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbow, pull the handle downward and inward toward your hip, by driving your elbow toward your side.
Pause briefly while squeezing your back muscles at the end of the movement.
Slowly return your arm to the starting position with control and repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching sides.
tips: Keep your torso upright and avoid rotating during the movement.
Squeeze your lats and rear shoulder at the bottom of each repetition.
Move through a controlled range of motion without using momentum.
Inhale as you return to the starting position and exhale as you pull the handle inward.
results.description: Cable Pull in Kneeling is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps, Upper Back, Core.
